errors.source_evidence: The header is a title block: the large "MERIDIAN SHIPPING" heading with a small tagline beneath it, and a "BILL OF LADING" box on the right with a rule under the title. B/L NO. and SCAC are label/value rows, with the values right-aligned.
errors.html_evidence: The header is plain stacked lines ("BILL OF LADING", "B/L NO. BL232472785", "SCAC MRDN"). The rule sits under the SCAC line instead of under the title, and the header cell is an oversized empty box.
errors.correction: Rebuild the header with the correct hierarchy: a large title, a rule under "BILL OF LADING", and label/value rows with right-aligned values.

errors.source_evidence: Each field has a small label with its value in a visibly larger, bolder style, e.g. BKG5917532 and MERIDIAN LABREA / 124N. The cargo section also has varied styles: larger fruit names, blue "SET TEMP" lines, italic "Packaging", and a large centered "FREIGHT COLLECT" between rules. "40" is large and centered, and "Authorized Signature" is large and right-aligned.
errors.html_evidence: All text is bold, in uniform small <pre> blocks, with no label/value hierarchy, no blue or italic styling, and no centered or ruled FREIGHT COLLECT. "40" and "Authorized Signature" are small, left-aligned plain text.
errors.correction: Apply the source's typographic hierarchy and alignment: labels vs. values, larger fruit names and temperatures, blue set-temp lines, italic packaging lines, and a centered ruled FREIGHT COLLECT.

errors.source_evidence: The cargo section is a table: each container row has its seal and marks, pallet count 20, a goods description, weight, and measurement. The two entries are visually separated, with 20 / 18,500 KGS / 28.00 CBM aligned with the apples entry and 20 / 19,200 KGS / 28.00 CBM aligned with the pears entry.
errors.html_evidence: The columns are absolutely positioned <div> cells holding <pre> text. All rows are packed together at the top of each cell, with no row alignment or spacing between the two goods entries, and no semantic <table>.
errors.correction: Use a semantic table with a row for each cargo entry, so that container, packages, description, weight, and measurement align per entry, with spacing between the entries.

errors.source_evidence: The charges row shows "OCEAN FREIGHT" at the left and "COLLECT" separated to the right.
errors.html_evidence: "OCEAN FREIGHT	COLLECT" is on one line, separated only by a tab, so COLLECT sits right next to the label.
errors.correction: Place COLLECT in a separate right-aligned column or cell.

errors.source_evidence: The legal text is small, regular-weight type with a rule above "NUMBER OF ORIGINAL B/L'S: THREE (3)", which is centered.
